title: 06-security.md §8.11 route_hash unimplementable post-AddrForKey: 'hop IID from address' has no mapping when primary embeds no IID
description: Found by bw88 codereview (pass 2 finding 1). spec/06-security.md §8.11 route_hash is 'concat(hop[0].iid, ...) -> SHA-256()[0:16]' where each hop[i].iid is 'the 8-byte IID from the transit node's address' (line ~792) and the egress recomputes it from the Source-Route Header (line ~833). SRH hops are primary 02xx addresses (05-routing.md). After the AddrForKey migration (98kb + bw88), a 02xx primary embeds NO IID — there is no spec-defined mapping from a 02xx hop address to an IID without the hop's pubkey, which the egress is not required to hold. Root (signer) and egress (validator) will diverge on the hash input (addr[8:16]? derive IID from pinned pubkeys? hash full hop addresses?), breaking egress authorization binding. Decide: (a) redefine route_hash over the 16-byte hop ADDRESSES (simplest, no IID needed — changes the hash input and any vectors); or (b) normatively require the egress to derive each hop's IID from a pinned pubkey via the trust store. Cross-file consequence of the AddrForKey migration; coordinate with tunnel_auth implementation (rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs, C tunnel_auth.c, vectors test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json).
